evidence: Changes CScriptWitness data representation and updates script evaluation in src/script/interpreter.cpp to parse witness stack elements on the fly as spans.
rationale: Mitigates an adversarial memory exhaustion vector by dropping worst-case allocated memory for transactions from roughly 28 bytes/WU to 1.6 bytes/WU. Changing CScriptWitness to store serialized stacks and parsing on the fly in the script interpreter provides durable validation-time DoS protection against crafted transactions with millions of tiny witness elements.
